pairs_touching.homonym_positive_evidence: S1023's A0-A6 (per-action autonomy: Read/Analyze/Verify/Recommend/Execute...) vs S1031's A0-A6 (per-agent maturity: standalone tool/repository-aware/knowledge-aware/governed/evidence-producing/authorized-action/continuously assured) are materially different level definitions under the identical index notation, with zero cross-reference between the two sources.
pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: Naming collision on 'A0..A6' worth flagging to governance as a namespace risk (echoes the I1-I15/I1-I20 collision pattern noted elsewhere in the corpus, e.g. RP0068's S1541 rows).
pairs_touching.what_says_this: Both use the identical notation range A0..A6 (SHARED-NOTATION grouping G0768), but the definitions diverge: A (S1023, Step 124) defines a per-ACTION autonomy-class scale (A0 Read/inspect, A1 Analyze, A2 Verify/execute deterministic checks, A3 Recommend, A4 Execute reversible low-risk action...); B's A-ladder (S1031, part of the Governance/Knowledge/Agent triad) defines an overall agent MATURITY stage (A0 standalone tool -> A1 repository-aware -> ... -> A6 continuously assured). Same ordinal shape and index range (both 7-level A0-A6 scales, so formally COMPATIBLE), different responsibility (per-action-autonomy vs whole-agent-maturity), and no lineage_claims or cross-reference in either direction connecting the two definitions -- meeting the 'different responsibility AND no continuity' HOMONYM bar.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: A row explicitly stating B's Agent maturity ladder A0-A6 IS Step 124's autonomy-class scale restated (a SOURCE-CLAIMED-IDENTITY/REFINEMENT claim), or that one supersedes the other, would collapse this to SAME or REFINEMENT instead.

pairs_touching.homonym_positive_evidence: Both are 7-level (0-6) 'maturity ladder' shaped constructs for KnowledgeOS, but explicitly different responsibility (G0-K0-A0 measure three separate capability dimensions; M0-M6 measures the operating model as a whole) with no continuity claimed -- an explicit 'distinct from... parallel to' statement.
pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: type_compatibility PARTIALLY-COMPATIBLE reflects the shared 7-level 0-6 numbering convention despite the differing scope.
pairs_touching.what_says_this: group_evidence (POSSIBLY-RELATION) states directly: Step 132's three ladders (G0-G6, K0-K6, A0-A6) are '...distinct from but parallel to the earlier M0-M6 operating-model-maturity-ladder (S1024/Step 125), which measures the operating model as a whole rather than these three separate dimensions.' This is an explicit differentiation: different responsibility (three separate capability dimensions vs one aggregate operating-model measure), with no claim that one was derived from or supersedes the other -- they are described as deliberately parallel, not continuous.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: A row showing the G/K/A three-ladder model was constructed specifically by decomposing the earlier M-ladder (rather than being independently designed and only later found parallel) would move this toward REFINEMENT instead of HOMONYM.
